title: Bloody Bites
description:
S19 E02 — We Joined a Cult; Daughters of Evil
A compilation of snack-sized horror films.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E07 — Queen of Sod; Slashr
While researching a book on Hollywood urban legends, Mike Campbell lands an interview with the son of "The Queen of Sod"; a young man named Ashkan is stalked by a killer known for deceiving his victims into sharing their locations on a dating app.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E01 — The Blue Diamond
Attending her estranged, narcissistic mother's funeral, grieving Alison discovers Jacqueline ran off to a mountain town to open an 80s après-ski club, but the club's cultish, robotic members in ski suits aren't just weird locals.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E02 — Banjo
Isaac is thrilled when his friend offers him the use of his family's cabin in the woods to lose his virginity; but when his first time goes horribly wrong, he begins to believe it may be the work of a cult.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S18 E03 — Escape; Obey!
Awakening on the floor of a destroyed suburban bedroom, a global invasion has begun, and the protagonist is not alone in the house; after the death of her dog Max, a pet influencer is confronted by a vengeful spirit demanding an apology.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S07 E01 — Air Conditions
An easy job turns into a struggle for survival for a HVAC repair man; stuck to the roof, he must escape before night falls and the real horror begins.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
